issues.description: Method name mismatch for the SealSaloon meal-cost operation: the problem statement (UML and requirements) names the static method calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int (see UML and the note that calculateTotalPrice must be static), but the provided code (solution) implements a static method named computeMealCost(Meal): int and Main (template/solution) calls computeMealCost(...). This naming inconsistency between the specification and the code will confuse students which method they should implement or call and may cause tests or examples to disagree with the textual requirements.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Preferred options: (A) Rename the implemented static method computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) in SealSaloon and update all call sites in Main and tests to calculateTotalPrice; or (B) Update the problem statement and UML to require computeMealCost(Meal) instead of calculateTotalPrice. Apply the chosen name consistently to the method signature, examples in Main, and the UML/description so students and tests refer to the same identifier.
